Some holidays are missing from the calendar. Why?

Two settings control what is displayed, both disabled by default. Include typical holidays brings in widely known holidays, such as New Year\'s Eve. Adult content reveals holidays marked as 18+, and enabling it requires age confirmation.
How do the month view modes differ?

Three modes are available, switched in Settings. In the simple mode the cell holds the day number only, which gives the calendar itself the best readability. The compact mode, used by default, adds the number of holidays falling on that day. The detailed mode shows the day number, the name of the first holiday (shortened when long) and a \"+N more\" note, with typical holidays in bold; it presents the most information at the cost of space in the cell.

In every mode a day with no holidays, once your filters are applied, is marked with a sad icon. If there are unusually many of them, check the settings described in question 1.

The holiday base is moderated continuously and grows from user submissions and from holidays found by the moderators. If a specific holiday is missing, suggest it: Menu » \"Suggest a holiday\". Attaching a reliable source considerably speeds up the review.

Every description in Ferrio is generated by artificial intelligence from publicly available sources. They are under no editorial supervision and have no author, so treat them as a starting point rather than a source: the model can get a date, a name or a historical circumstance wrong while sounding just as confident as when it is right. Verify important facts elsewhere and report any mistakes you notice - they do get corrected.

Formally: descriptions created by artificial intelligence carry the \"AI-generated\" label, in line with the transparency requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the AI Act).
I found an error in a description or a date. What should I do?

Open the holiday and choose \"Report\". The report goes to a moderator and the decision is visible in Menu » \"My reports\". A review usually takes up to a week; for complex reports, or when a moderator is away, it can take up to a month. Simple errors are corrected by hand, more complex ones require the description to be generated again.
How do I suggest a new holiday?

Choose Menu » \"Suggest a holiday\", then set the holiday type: fixed (always falls on the same day, for example 2 August) or floating (the date follows a rule, for example the second Tuesday of the month).
What do the statuses of my reports and suggestions mean?

Reported means the submission is awaiting a moderator decision, and On hold that the moderator has withheld that decision. Applied means it was accepted and the holiday is already in the calendar; Already exists has the same effect, for holidays that were in the calendar beforehand. Declined means it was not accepted, and Duplicate that an identical submission arrived earlier. Unknown is a state the app does not recognize; if it appears, please report it as an error.

Entries carrying a moderator note are marked with a comment icon, which opens the note.

Every rejection carries a moderator note with the reason - open the entry in \"My suggestions\" and read the note. The most common reason is the lack of a reliable source confirming that the holiday exists.
What is the difference between an anonymous account and a Google account?

An anonymous account lets you browse the calendar, open descriptions and search for holidays. A Google account additionally lets you suggest new holidays, report errors and review the history of your own submissions along with their statuses and moderator notes. A disabled \"Report\" button, or no access to \"My suggestions\", means you are using an anonymous account. You can sign in at any time without losing any of your current access.
Can I delete my account and data?
An anonymous account is deleted automatically the moment you sign out and leaves no data behind. For a Google account, please write to the address given in the privacy policy: ferrio.app/en/privacy.
Yes. Holidays are stored on the device and remain available with no internet connection. A network is required to refresh the data, to sign in and to send suggestions and reports.
How do I know my data is up to date?
The app downloads holidays on launch, when the list is pulled down and after the filtering settings change. A failed download is signalled by a bar with a \"Retry\" button.
The widget is not showing today.

The widget refreshes itself at midnight and roughly every 30 minutes, as well as after every data refresh in the app and after a settings change. If it shows stale content, open the app and pull the list down. Should that not help, remove the widget from the screen and add it again - this is the most reliable way to force a rebuild.
